subject: Packaging options for CareWell pilot — upgrade window & feature bundling
messages:
From: Ellie Chang <ellie@carewell.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: CareWell Procurement <procurement@carewell.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Packaging options for pilot: upgrade window & feature bundling

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency numbers and the observability dashboard. We're kicking off a 3-month pilot next month and need clarity on how Redwood's packaging works for short pilots that may expand into a multi-region rollout. A couple quick questions: 

- If we start on the Compact tier with the inference cache add-on, is there a simple path to upgrade to Dedicated capacity mid-pilot without a multi-month commitment?
- Can feature bundles be split (e.g., keep the quantization/optimize features but drop advanced role-based routing) or are bundles treated atomically for billing?
- We're also assessing an early-termination downgrade option if usage stays below 30% of committed throughput after month 2 — do you support prorated refunds or crediting toward usage?

Would you be able to share a short one-pager and an indicative pricing range so we can include it in our pilot kickoff memo? Also cc'ing procurement for any contract constraints.

Best,
Ellie Chang
Sr. Product Manager, CareWell Health

---

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Packaging options for pilot: upgrade window & feature bundling

Hi Ellie — great to hear pilot is greenlit. Attached is a compact package sketch plus a recommended MAP (pilot-MAP.xlsx) that outlines two upgrade paths. TL;DR: yes, you can upgrade mid-pilot; how painless it is depends on whether you need dedicated GPUs or just higher shared throughput.

Key points:
- Upgrade UX: We support an online tier upgrade with a rolling capacity migration. If moving to Dedicated capacity we recommend a 2-week window to reserve GPU pools; during that window traffic routes to compatible variants (no downtime).
- Bundles: Features are modular at the billing layer — you can keep Optimize and Quantization while disabling Role Routing. On our invoice these are line-itemed so bundling can be rebalanced mid-contract.
- Early downgrade: We offer a pro-rated credit model (not cash refunds) for pilot reductions inside the first 60 days. Credits can be applied against future usage or toward the first month of Dedicated if you convert.

I've attached: PackagingOptions_CareWell_v1.pdf (package sketches) and the pilot-MAP.xlsx with estimated token bands and indicative pricing. Ben — flag any commercial constraints or promotional band we can offer for a pilot-to-dedicated conversion.

Next steps:
1) Ellie: confirm whether you want the Dedicated reservation flow to be manual (procurement sign-off) or auto-triggered at a usage threshold (we can set 60% sustained for 48h).
2) If procurement needs standard SOW/term tweaks I'll draft a minimal amendment for the pilot.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: PackagingOptions_CareWell_v1.pdf (design sketch), pilot-MAP.xlsx (usage bands)

Ellie — quick commercial note. We can offer a pilot conversion credit if CareWell commits to a 12-month Dedicated contract within 30 days of pilot end. Options: 

A) 1-month free Dedicated credit applied at conversion (standard)
B) 10% one-time conversion discount on committed monthly fee (requires sales approval)
C) Keep compact pricing but add Optimize + Quantization at a 25% add-on discount during the pilot (simpler procurement path)

For your procurement team: pilot amendments are covered by our standard pilot addendum (no long-term lock) — I can attach a redline if helpful. Also, if you'd like the auto-trigger threshold, we should lock the metric and a max failback window to avoid accidental over-provisioning.

Marissa — can you confirm whether we have flexibility on option B (10% conversion discount) for CW-1893? If not, we'll propose option C as the recommended pilot incentive.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
